desc: Identify that paths avoiding the update rectangle must be retained via frozen total minus rectangle contribution.

Verify both public samples; the current implementation passes both public samples.
Confirm movement-before-assignment semantics, zero handling, and modular arithmetic in the current implementation.
Replace the current block method with a provably feasible full-constraint algorithm.
